question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Hilarious
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Humourless​.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let us see the meaning of Hilarious:

 
 
• Hilarious: extremely funny. (बहुत मज़ेदार, हास्‍यक)
 
 
 
• Let us see the meanings of the given options:
 
 
• **Ridiculous: **very silly or unreasonable. (मूखर्तापूर्ण या बेतुका)
 
• **Pretentious: **trying to appear more serious or important than you really are. (वास्‍तविकता से अधिक गंभीर या बड़ा होने का दिखावा करने वाला; मिथ्‍याभिमानी, आडंबरी, बनावटी)
 
• **Usual: **happening or used most often. (बहुधा होने या प्रयोग में आने वाला, हमेशा वाला)
 
• **Humourless: **having no sense of fun; serious. (हँसी-मज़ाक पसंद न करने वाला; गंभीर)
 
 
 
• From the meanings of the given words, we can say that the word "Humourless" is the appropriate antonym for the word 'Hilarious​.'
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Option 4.
